programme.desc: 'S13/E1'. Jaco Cloete en sy vrou was gesiene lede van die Melkbosstrand-gemeenskap tot sy inhegtenisneming vir beweerde bedrog. Hy het aanklagte van miljoene rande geëis en uiteindelik bankrotskap verklaar.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S13/E4'. Cheryl-Ann Kannemeyer, 'n bekende plaaslike eiendomsagent, is met ernstige beserings dood gevind in haar motor. Vriende en familie was geskok toe die misdadiger haar eie man is.

programme.title: Tafel-toere

programme.title: Ons gesels gesondheid

programme.desc: 'S7/E22 - Paris: Second Bite'. Andrew Zimmern returns to the European epicentre of fashion, art and food - Paris. He finds the best eateries and tries dishes like fresh steak tartare.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S21/E13 - Single-Aisle Showdowns'. Guy Fieri makes the chefs shop in just one aisle for each round of the competition. Which competitor will win a shopping spree worth up to $20,000?

programme.title: Best Bite In Town
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Tulsa'. Noah Cappe, Aarti Sequeira and Joe Sasto to explore Italian and Caribbean cuisine, banh mi, delicatessen fare and elevated cowboy cooking in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

programme.title: Chopped Castaways
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Stay Afloat'. Risk and reward collide when the final five chefs race into open water to retrieve their protein, with the most desirable ingredients far from shore.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S40/E13 - Pasta Royalty'. Nadia Caterina Munno and Christian Petroni hold court with chefs Kelsey Murphy and Michael Reed to dub Bobby Flay a loser.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S40/E14 - Are We Having Fun Yet?'. Carson Kressley teams up with Ayesha Nurdjaja as chefs Laurence Louie and Logan Sandoval put Bobby Flay to the test with a dish he's never heard of.

programme.title: Bobby And Giada In Italy
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Wine Country'. Bobby and Giada source high-end local ingredients and visit an iconic winery in the hills of Tuscany. Then, they suit up to learn the art of beekeeping.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S30/E12 - All You Can Eat BBQ'. The hosts are cooking up big batch BBQ dishes for a great summer party! They serve up an easy smokehouse burger and herbed potato salad.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S35/E2 - Asian And American'. Guy goes to Alaska to try a Korean-Mexican joint rolling out kimchi burritos before heading to New Mexico for funky fusion pork belly.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S57/E9 - Truffle Kerfuffle'. It's a kerfuffle in the kitchen as four chefs work with prized fungi in every round. A pricey cut of meat in the entrée basket puts pressure on the chefs.

programme.title: Chopped Junior
programme.desc: 'S7/E4 - Champions: Part 3'. The youngest group of chefs competes for a spot in the finale. They must delicate seafood, chocolates in disguise and coffee and chili flakes in the dessert.

programme.title: Halloween Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E2 - GSI: Ghost Scene Investigators'. Three new teams are given a case file to create their own crime scene with tasting elements that include coffee and doughnuts.

programme.title: Outrageous Pumpkins
programme.desc: 'S3/E3 - Sky-High Scares'. Sunny Anderson challenges the pumpkin carvers to bring a frightening phobia to life and then depict a circus sideshow gone terribly wrong.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S37/E12 - Homemade Holiday'. Ree Drummond makes festive, edible Christmas gifts for friends, including spiced rolls, yummy onion jam, a cookie baking kit and a comforting soup.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S8/E10 - All About Family'. The final four bakers are challenged to make a cherished family recipe and an heirloom wedding cake. The judges crown the champion and award the $25,000 prize!

programme.title: Triple D Nation: Steak, Sausage...

programme.title: Flavortown Food Fight
